fragment:
<set-variable name="mcp" value="@(context.Request.Body.As(preserveContent:true))" />
	
	
	
	
	
	
	
	
	
	
		{{PingOneTokenUrl}}
		POST
		
			@{
                    var clientId = "{{PingOneClientId}}";
                    var clientSecret = "{{PingOneClientSecret}}";

                    return "Basic " +
                        Convert.ToBase64String(
                            System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(clientId + ":" + clientSecret)
                        );
                }
		
		
			application/x-www-form-urlencoded
		
		grant_type=client_credentials&scope=openid
	
	<set-variable name="accessToken" value="@((string)((IResponse)context.Variables["tokenResponse"]).Body.As()["access_token"])" />
	
	
	
	
		{{PingOneDecisionEndpoint}}
		POST
		
			@("Bearer " + (string)context.Variables["accessToken"])
		
		
			application/json
		
		
			application/json
		
		
			Azure-APIM
		
		@{
                    var parameters = new JObject();
                    parameters["gateway.type"] = "MS-APIM";
                    parameters["gateway.service"] = (string)context.Variables["pazService"];
                    parameters["gateway.method"] = (string)context.Variables["method"];
                    parameters["gateway.bearerToken"] = (string)context.Variables["incomingBearer"];
                    parameters["gateway.requestId"] = (string)context.Variables["requestId"];
                    
                    var tool = (string)context.Variables["tool"];
                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(tool))
                    {
                        parameters["gateway.tool"] = tool;
                    }

                    var args = (string)context.Variables["arguments"];
                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(args))
                    {
                        parameters["gateway.arguments"] = args;
                    }

                    return new JObject(
                        new JProperty("parameters", parameters)
                    ).ToString();}
            
	
	
	
	
	<set-variable name="p1az" value="@(((IResponse)context.Variables["p1azResponse"]).Body.As())" />
	
	
	
		
			
			
			
			
			
				
				
					application/json
				
				@{
                        return new JObject(
                            new JProperty("error",
                                new JObject(
                                    new JProperty("code", (string)context.Variables["errorCode"]),
                                    new JProperty("message", (string)context.Variables["errorMessage"]),
                                    new JProperty("obligatory", (bool)context.Variables["obligatory"]),
                                    new JProperty("fulfilled", (bool)context.Variables["fulfilled"])
                                )
                            )
                        ).ToString();
                    }
